$schema_note: Canonical Phase-0 snapshot of the pipeline_output.json external contract. Types are JSON types as serialized. 'required' = present in every successful run produced by tests/test_orchestrator.py (the production runner). Compatibility rule: existing keys are FROZEN (no rename, no removal, no type change); future additions must be NEW keys (additive-only, IP-5 pattern).
consumers: backend/server.py (loaded at import; REST slices + /ws/pipeline replay)

status.description: 'complete' only when the final network plan was independently verified (network_ledger.verified); 'incomplete_accounting' otherwise (never a silent success)

problem_analysis.description: Narrative problem analysis (LLM or deterministic fallback)

summary_metrics.description: Global KPIs; coverage is canonical gdwc (T0-3)
summary_metrics.note: total_runtime is runtime-variable; all others are structural

iteration_audit.description: Per-iteration audit rows; length MUST be 3 (MIN=MAX_ITERATIONS)

selected_services.description: Services of the SELECTED iteration (rebuilt from best_snapshot)

llm_runtime_aggregate.description: Provider/model usage + router telemetry + actuation ledger

network_ledger.description: Verified network plan (services, weekly departures, routed flows) with the independently recomputed weekly economics, fleet use per class, demand conservation, stated time/price assumptions, MILP-vs-ledger reconciliation and violations
network_ledger.note: when no verified ledger was produced the block carries verified=false, status and message instead

test_scorecard.description: Added by the runner wrapper (not by OrchestratorAgent itself): assertions_passed/failed/total/warnings/score

selected_service_item.note: WorldMap.jsx consumes id/ports/region; fleetStats.js derives fleet stats from these records client-side. frequency_per_week / vessels / cycle_time_days were added (additive, network-economics redesign): departures per week, vessels tied up = ceil(cycle_time_days * frequency / 7), and the declared rotation time in days derived from distance, class design speed and port stay.

structural_expectations.description: Must hold in EVERY successful run. Enforced by certification suite and/or schema tests.
rules: top-level key SET equals the 21 required keys (the original 20 + network_ledger; +test_scorecard when produced via runner)
exactly one iteration_audit row has selected_as_final == true
iteration_selection.selection_method startswith 'deterministic' OR llm agreed with deterministic winner
every regional_result_item / selected_service_item contains its frozen key set

runtime_variable_values.description: Legitimately change between runs; never hard-code as expectations.

future_additions.rule: Maritime intelligence adds ONE new optional top-level key 'maritime_intelligence' (IP-5). Existing consumers ignore unknown keys (verified runtimeAdapter ??-chain tolerance). No other additive surface is sanctioned without CHANGE_CONTROL entry. SANCTIONED ADDITION (network-economics redesign, see MIGRATION_NOTE_NETWORK_ECONOMICS.md): required top-level key 'network_ledger' (the verified network plan and its independent recomputation), three additive fields on selected_service_item, and the 'status' value domain widened from {'complete'} to {'complete','incomplete_accounting'} so that an unverified network is never reported as a success.
forbidden: changing units or scales of existing fields

addenda.compatibility: additive only; no key renamed, removed or re-typed; the frozen key sets above are unchanged

decision_output.global_metrics.total_cost: semantics corrected: ALL-IN weekly cost (hire + fuel + port + handling + transshipment); it was the vessel-hire component only (F-15)
decision_output.global_metrics.profit_margin_pct: semantics corrected: 100 * profit / revenue on the all-in cost; null when the accounting is not verified or revenue <= 0

iteration_results[].metrics.note: operating_cost keeps its component meaning (vessel hire); total_cost is the all-in cost iteration selection compares

network_ledger.assumptions.bunker_price_usd_per_t: uniform legacy price, or the snapshot's reference price in regional_snapshot mode (see fuel_pricing.mode)
